name: BP Appointments - HHC Community Advisory Boards (CAB)
description:
This dataset lists members of Community Advisory Boards (CABs) tied to a public health system, with 90 sampled rows covering five boards: Kings County Hospital, Cumberland Diagnostic Center, Coney Island Hospital, Woodhull Hospital, and East New York Diagnostic and Treatment Center. Each row records a member's board, first and last name, role (such as BP Appointee, Executive Director, Chair, Vice Chair, Secretary, or Treasurer), term of office, term effective date, term expiration date, and voting status.

Coverage is uneven across fields. Names are present for most members, while term of office is missing for about 46% of rows and voting status for about 49%. Term effective dates are sparse, appearing in only a few records. Where terms are recorded, three-year terms dominate, with a smaller number of two-year terms. Voting members make up nearly all of those with a recorded status.

The data supports tracking board composition and membership turnover, comparing appointment patterns
